question: What abundant or additional level may be placed above the described structure?
premises: The upper part may be made as desired.
It may be endowed with abundance.
Another level may be added above.
inference: Above that, one may add an abundant section or another level as desired.
uncertainties: janāntaram may mean interval or another tier depending on context.
plain_english: Above that, one may make it as desired and abundant, or add another level.
